title.narrative: Local Civil Society Contributes to Inclusive and Sustainable Economic Development in Moldova

description.narrative: To empower vulnerable women and men to exploit sustainable economic opportunities, reap the benefits provided by the AA/DCFTA and to be better prepared to manage economic risks (such as COVID-19 pandemic) through active civil society engagement. The project proposal will focus on the following vulnerable women and men: returning workers, youth, persons with disabilities, unemployed people as a result of pandemics such as COVID-19, unemployed Roma, older people with special needs.
